title: HOSTILE SEMANTIC APPEAL

principal_challenges.holding: Current law establishes distinct jurisdictions and noncollapse, not a generic present multi-lane semantic use for one arbitrary empirical configuration. Structural and mediation promotion require exact authority edges that D09 itself finds missing. Future-authorizability is not current semantic use.

D08 establishes empirical fact/configuration identity. The Full Machine Vision uses historical structural/meaning-field language as governing research orientation and D12 treats historically plausible local meaning-fields as a terminal capability to test; neither fact creates a current producer-owned empirical object named POPULATION_MEANING_FIELD.

The token makes a positive capability-necessity claim that belongs to D12. D07 establishes reconstructibility only for separately authorized future queries. D08 establishes representational noncollapse, not terminal necessity. D11 explicitly leaves stranded-meaning necessity unresolved.

A generic empirical-configuration-to-structural lane is not current authority. Existing structural production is narrow and producer-specific. ADP-001 requires an exact already-governed V552 structural fact plus exact V552J association/admission/use authority and structural reference bindings. The mere possibility of a future authority does not establish a current semantic lane.

Current ADP-001/ADP-002 authorize exact actor-independent structural affordance and mediation-route candidates from already-governed structural bases/channels. They do not authorize a generic survey-configuration-derived framework-availability object. ADP-002 adds no framework/domain label or unary effect absent exact upstream authority.

sustained_d09_holdings: Current E3 attitude-cloud composite and E4 association functionals are derived/lossy diagnostic or compatibility surfaces rather than primary empirical facts.
Historical profile/persona assignment from survey covariance is superseded as an actor-generation mechanism.
Population/survey evidence cannot directly assign actor belief probability or actor belief.
Same generated structural position may lawfully yield divergent actor answers/beliefs through different V3 histories.
Supported minority empirical configurations must not be converted into impossibility or typed absence.
Bounded governed V550J joint configurations have a real current consumer path through V551J/V552J/V553.
A future authority could in principle admit an empirical distinction into a later structural use, but the modal possibility creates no current necessity or authority.
No generic current attitude-cloud consumer is demonstrated.
D09 terminal necessity is correctly deferred to D12; this boundary should control stronger contradictory REQUIRED wording.

d03_profile_posterior_appeal.appeal_holding: E1/E2/E0B validity must be justified from current D08 empirical algebra and exact current authority, not by calling them the lawful descendant of historical profile-posterior intent. Historical genealogy may identify the information-loss question but cannot confer current semantic necessity or downstream jurisdiction.

d07_workload_appeal.appeal_holding: For an authorized future query, the exact fact/configuration must remain reconstructible. This does not decide which query classes D12 will find terminally necessary.

d10_structural_boundary.appeal_effect: Raw empirical predicates, joint configurations and coordinate labels remain empirical evidence. They do not satisfy generated structural-position predicates or acquire structural relation meaning by statistical context alone.

d11_consumer_boundary.appeal_holding: A consumer for selected V550J packet semantics is not evidence of a generic population-meaning-field consumer or of semantic equivalence among arbitrary E1/E2/E0B facts.

d12_jurisdiction.appeal_holding: D09 may prove semantic non-equivalence and identify candidate terminal questions. It may not positively classify generic E1/E2/E0B or a population-meaning-field capability as REQUIRED before D12 provides a concrete starvation demonstration.
